clips.title: The story
paras: In Ratchet, Gazlowe waits for goods sent from Booty Bay across the Great Sea. He sends couriers to Wharfmaster Dizzywig to check the dock records, while the Southsea Freebooters remain a possible cause of the delay.

Ratchet is the Steamwheedle Cartel's trading port on Kalimdor. Ships cross the Great Sea from Booty Bay with manufactured goods, exotic supplies, and heavy freight for the town's building and trade. When cargo goes missing, business suffers. Chief Engineer Gazlowe keeps close track of every crate brought into port.

The Southsea Freebooters haunt the coast south of Ratchet and often intercept merchant ships. Gazlowe checks his records before accusing the pirates or sending anyone into a fight. He sends his inventory ledger to Wharfmaster Dizzywig at the docks. Dizzywig oversees the unloading and storage of ship cargo, and can check whether goods were lost at sea or misplaced in a warehouse.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I've been waiting forever for my last shipment of goods from Booty Bay! I'm pretty sure that it must have been stolen by the Freebooters, but just to make sure, will you go down to the dockside and ask Dizzywig if my goods were already put into my warehouse without my knowledge?
Here, take my ledger down to Dizzywig and have him double check my inventory records against his logs.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Wares to send on the next ship, friend?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, Gazlowe sent you, did he? Just a moment, let me take a look here and check my own logs and make sure I didn't have Gazlowe's shipment sent to the wrong place.
Bet he's waiting for those boots from Drizzlek...
